rules: Generated user kernel projects must not reference Inu.Kernel.X64.LowLevel directly.
Generic kernel-facing APIs must not expose X64, Arm64, CRx, MSR, APIC or architecture-specific page-entry encodings.
Architecture implementations may consume private low-level assemblies; code above the boundary consumes Inu.Kernel.Architecture or higher-level kernel services.
Adding ARM64 later requires a Inu.Arch.Arm64 implementation without changing generic kernel API consumers.

compatibility.legacyInternalX64Consumers: Existing SDK internals that still consume Inu.Kernel.X64.LowLevel are retained as internal implementation details and can be migrated incrementally. New generated-kernel top-level references are prohibited.
